q: The Rohlin entropy of a countable Borel equivalence relation E generated by a free ergodic action of a countable amenable group Γ equals:
opts: The topological entropy of the Cayley graph
h(E) = inf{H(𝒫) : 𝒫 is an E-generating partition} — the minimum entropy of a generating partition, which equals the KS entropy of the action
exp: Rohlin entropy: h(E) = inf{H(𝒫) : 𝒫 generates E}. Tucker-Drob and Seward proved that for free actions of countable amenable groups, Rohlin entropy equals KS entropy. For non-amenable groups, Rohlin entropy provides an extension of KS entropy.
